Public Franklin signals

Know what may affect your customers and operations.

Use public Franklin information as planning context—not as a claim that a lead or sale exists. Franklin Navigator does not currently use private resident conversations or individual search histories to create these signals.

This week’s public planning prompts

Turn Franklin context into useful business actions.

These prompts use public calendars and local conditions—not private resident behavior. Confirm the source before acting because dates and conditions can change.

School-calendar week

Ask whether staffing, family schedules, hours or customer communications need a small adjustment around late starts, early dismissals or breaks.

Put this into my weekly plan

Downtown / event activity

If an event affects your area, check access and parking first; then decide whether useful customer information or participation makes sense.

Check current public dates

What becomes operational next

R18 creates one understandable business operating surface. Verified account control, profile publishing, member analytics, offers, jobs, events, billing and team permissions still require the secure member-account backend before they can be opened safely.

Paid enrollment remains closed until identity, authority, billing, entitlements, support and cancellation are operational together.
